name: Kuzunoha
source:
A fox-eared shrine maiden. Though her age is unknown and she looks young she actually around 200 years old, her speech and thinking are quite anachronistic.

Even though she has white hair, fox ears and a tail Soushirou is the only one who sees her this way as to everyone else she appears as a normal black haired girl.
